featured_reviews.name: Esha Sidhu
featured_reviews.review_text:
On 30th May 2026, I attended the final performance of Curious Curtains Summer Camp, and I was truly amazed.

In just 5 days, the children confidently presented theatre, storytelling, singing, dance, and action-based performances on meaningful topics. The creativity, confidence, and expression displayed by these young children were remarkable. A special appreciation to Trupti for designing such a unique and thoughtful program.

Watching these children brought back memories of my own childhood. I never had opportunities like this to perform on stage when I was young, and I truly feel that this is one of the reasons I developed fear and hesitation while speaking in front of others. Seeing these children express themselves so confidently made me realize how valuable such experiences are in building self-confidence from an early age.

I would like to encourage all parents to enroll their children in activities like theatre and stage performances from an early age. These programs are not about creating actors; they are about building confidence, communication skills, creativity, and personality. The lessons children learn here stay with them for life.

What impressed me most was seeing 4 to 6-year-old children standing fearlessly on stage and expressing themselves so beautifully. Experiences like these help shape confident individuals for the future.

Congratulations to Trupti and the entire Curious Curtain team for creating such a meaningful and impactful experience for children. Wishing you continued success in nurturing young minds.
